    "Meter register reads for disputed and prior periods (provided)",

    "Complete billing calculation showing application of rate components to billed kWh",
    "Historical usage trend (provided)",
    "Customer-provided information on occupancy, appliances, or usage pattern changes during the period",
    "Weather/temperature data for billing period (to explain seasonal consumption)",
    "Any recent rate or tariff changes affecting the account (rate sheet/policy lookup)"
  ],
  "missing_evidence": [
    "Customer statement about occupancy/behavior or known appliance/malfunction changes in July 2026",
    "Weather/temperature summary for July 2026 at service location",
    "Detailed bill calculation (itemized bill showing energy vs fixed charges; not included explicitly in synthetic record)",
    "On-site meter inspection or physical tamper evidence (no meter events recorded; none present)",

  "triage_summary": "Customer reports a large increase from 640 kWh in June to 870 kWh in July and asserts the meter is broken. Synthetic account shows consecutive actual reads (41820 -> 42690), an increase consistent with billed kWh, and a remote self-test on 2026-07-29 with result PASS and no tamper or register fault flags. No meter events or prior adjustments recorded. Required next steps: verify billing calculation and rate application, obtain customer confirmation of any usage/occupancy changes or appliance issues, retrieve local weather/temperature for July 2026, and determine whether an on-site inspection or escalation is warranted per policy. Because the customer alleges meter failure, flag for human review and follow regulator/billing accuracy policy lookup before any correction or commitment."
}
